name: Chippy Candy Co
notes: The business's own site (Chippy Candy Company – Lava Crunch peanut and macadamia brittle) lists Honolulu as its location, not Windward, and it carries no market schedule. The contact page shows the handle @contactchippycandy but does not say which platform it is on, so Instagram is left null. The 'order_url' is the site itself, which has a buy button for the brittle. The contact page was updated about 114 days ago, so I marked it active.

name: Da Manju Lady
notes: Plenty of Aloha, the market organizer, lists Da Manju Lady under its Windward Mall Market vendors. Marketspread has a vendor page (Honolulu, HI 96816) that says an Instagram account exists but gives no handle, so Instagram is null. The Marketspread zip is Honolulu, not Windward. Neither source is dated, so I could not confirm the vendor is currently active. Not the same as Maui Manjookies, which is a different business.

name: Da Poi Boi
notes: A recent third-party article (Aloha Girl, about 17 days old) credits Toshio Toguchi as @dapoiboi808 and says he is selling poi at farmers markets and events. Plenty of Aloha also lists Da Poi Boi among its market vendors. The article does not name Oʻahu, so the match relies on the Plenty of Aloha listing. I did not open the Instagram account itself. No weekly schedule was found; the organizer page is only a vendor list.

name: Datz Fiyah!
notes: The only source is the Honolulu Festival organizer page for the 2025 (29th) festival. It describes a mother-and-daughter business, established 2024, selling li hing mui gummies, lollipops and baked goods. No Instagram, Facebook or website was found, and none can be tied to this exact business. Active status is unconfirmed beyond the 2025 festival. No side is stated in the sources.

name: Dip Into Paradise
notes: The Instagram handle comes from a third-party retailer page (The Mākeke), not from the business's own site; the Facebook page and website are the business's own. Its Facebook page posts Windward Mall Farmers Market reminders, and its site has a 'Find us at an Oahu event' section and holiday gift boxes. The business is based in Kāneʻohe. The site sells online and offers free U.S. shipping on orders of $100 or more.

name: Elsie's Toffee
notes: Nothing found for an Oʻahu toffee vendor by this name. The searches only returned Elsie's Smoothie Shack in Lāʻie, which is a different business, so I did not attach any accounts.

name: Georgi's Goodies
notes: The Linktree (linktr.ee/georgis.goodies) links to the Instagram and Facebook accounts. A KHON2 story from about 115 days ago gives the Windward Mall Farmers Market in Kāneʻohe on Sundays, 10 a.m.–2 p.m., and online ordering at georgisgoodies.com. The Facebook page also lists georgisgoodies.square.site. It is a home bakery, so I left out the home address. Windward side fits (Kāneʻohe).

name: Green Times Matcha
notes: Star-Advertiser (Apr and Aug 2026) and Aloha State Daily (Aug 2026) all give the handle @greentimes.matcha and say the monthly pop-up schedule is posted on Instagram. A weekly Thursday pop-up at fishcake, 307 Kamani St in Kakaʻako, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., was reported in April 2026. The August 2026 coverage describes ongoing pop-ups and a Made in Hawaiʻi Festival booth, and September 2026 coverage lists it at a West Oʻahu matcha festival. I did not open the Instagram account and found no website or Facebook page. Side is town.

name: HB Baking
notes: This is Slice by HB Baking (ice cream pies and cakes, plus a mobile dessert truck). The Honolulu location is on Kapahulu Ave; the Facebook page and a Nextdoor listing say Honolulu (Kapahulu/Ala Hekili Pl), so the seed's 'Central' does not match. The homepage says the shop is temporarily closed during a move and that the truck can be booked for events. I could not tell whether it still sells at markets. No Instagram handle was found. An online ordering page exists on talech, but I left it out because the shop is closed and the page may be stale.

name: Haitai Hawaii
notes: This is a non-food vendor: handmade bags and decor made from Japanese obi, run by Eriko Paquin. The Etsy shop lists Mililani Town and the Eventeny profile says Mililani, so this is central Oʻahu, not Town/Honolulu as in the seed. The Eventeny page lists craft fairs in Waipahu (Nov 2025) and Mililani Town (Apr 2026), both completed. The Facebook page posts a Craft & Collectibles Fair at the Japanese Cultural Center of Hawaii, with no year visible. No own website was found. The Etsy snippet is dated, so the order link may be stale; Pinterest says to DM on Instagram to purchase.

name: Harrison's Mustard
notes: The site is branded MUSTARDMAN808 and sells Harrison's Mustard. Its schedule lists the Windward Mall Farmers Market on Sundays, 10 a.m.–2 p.m., plus Wednesday and Tuesday dates (Kaiser High School Market) through August 2026, and Koko Marina Shopping Center on Aug 15, 2026. It also says it ships, with no order URL given. Phone (808) 222-6043. No Instagram or Facebook handle was found. The latest dates on the page are from August 2026, so the schedule may be out of date.

name: Hawaii Bake Shop
notes: No Windward vendor matching this name was found. The search returned other bakeries (Hokulani, Ani's, Liliha and others), which are different businesses.

name: Hawaii Best Hawaiian Haupia
notes: The Facebook page is titled Hawaii's Best Hawaiian Haupia (Honolulu, HI) and describes hand-packed dessert mixes made in Hawaii. The website domain comes from that Facebook page; I did not open the site. No market schedule or Instagram was found. Aloha Specialties (a retailer) carries the brand, but I did not use a retailer as its order page. Facebook says Honolulu, not Windward. Activity could not be confirmed because the page has no dates.

name: Hawaii's Best Ever Nuts and Candies
notes: No sources found for this business. The search returned Big Island Candies, Hawaiian Host and other unrelated candy sellers, which I did not attach.

name: Hawaiian Pie Company
notes: My dedicated search for this vendor did not run, so I have no accounts to give. The only evidence is Hawaiian Pie Company appearing in the Shop Small Hawaii food and drinks directory, which gives no links or dates. Whether it is on Oʻahu and its activity status are unverified.
